text.arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ جَعَلَ ٱلسِّقَايَةَ فِى رَحْلِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا ٱلْعِيرُ إِنَّكُمْ لَسَٰرِقُونَ

words.gloss_range: clause-opening sequence particle fused with the following temporal hinge
words.prose: The opening {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the ayah continue from the prior scene and immediately binds that continuation to the following temporal hinge. Its payoff is not just "and"; the verse begins as a consequential launch whose response will be the hidden placement.

topics.headline: fa-lamma consequential hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verse open as "so when," a dependent launch toward the placement rather than a loose continuation.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes words 1-5 the temporal frame, so the fa claim survives as part of the fa-lamma hinge.

topics.headline: continuation from private disclosure into stratagem
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cup scene is grammatically carried forward from the prior private disclosure rather than reset as an isolated event.
topics.reason: The clause-initial particle and boundary rows cohere with the ayah opening as a new narrative beat after the previous scene.

words.gloss_range: completed-temporal particle governing the provisioning clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَمَّا}} ({{tr:lammā}}) turns the visible provisioning into a completed precondition before the concealed act. The main placement is delayed until the brothers have been fully equipped, so the first clause is a trigger, not loose background; as a fixed particle, it keeps attention on temporal completion rather than a live lexical-root image.

topics.headline: completed provisioning triggers the response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the hidden placement waits until the equipping is complete.
topics.reason: QAC marks lamma as an adverbial temporal conjunction governing the perfect verb, and the clause evidence makes the following placement the response.

topics.headline: dependent frame gives preparation structural weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the visible preparation occupying the foreground before the secret act appears.
topics.reason: The temporal clause spans words 1-5 and is elaborated before the main verb at word 6.

topics.headline: fixed particle blocks root curiosity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the focus on temporal completion, not on an unrelated lexical-root image.
topics.reason: The local item is an indeclinable temporal particle; any root-based curiosity is not the local mechanism.

words.gloss_range: completed Form II outfitting of the brothers, with them as attached object
words.root_gloss_range: equipment and readiness for travel; secondary final-preparation associations are narrowed to transition pressure here
words.prose: {{ar:جَهَّزَهُمْ}} ({{tr:jahhazahum}}) says that the brothers were fully outfitted before the cup was inserted. The Form II completion, the attached object suffix, and the immediate equipment noun make the opening feel like a generous travel-provisioning frame that is also the setup for detention, with the same rare provisioning language echoing 12:59.

topics.headline: Form II completed outfitting of the brothers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers are fully provisioned recipients before they become accused addressees.
topics.reason: The suffix is the object, the verb is perfect Form II, and the subject is recoverable as Yusuf in the scene.

topics.headline: complete travel-kit pressure with final-preparation undertone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the outfitting as a complete transition kit, while the darker final-preparation association remains an undertone rather than the selected sense.
topics.reason: The local sense is travel provisioning; broader preparation domains can sharpen transition pressure but cannot replace that sense.

topics.headline: rare provisioning verb reprises 12:59
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second visit staged in the same rare provisioning vocabulary used in 12:59.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence treats this root form as low occurrence and concentrated in the Joseph provisioning scenes.

topics.headline: verb-noun echo saturates the opening beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the outfitting action immediately turning into the equipment domain through a cognate echo.
topics.reason: The verb is followed by its cognate equipment noun under the bi phrase, creating a tight opening provisioning unit.

words.gloss_range: instrumental or accompaniment preposition governing the equipment noun
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the equipment phrase the means or accompaniment of the completed outfitting. It keeps the noun from becoming a second direct object and makes the cognate repetition read as governed provisioning: he equipped them with their equipment.

topics.headline: bi marks means and accompaniment of outfitting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gear as the means/content that completes the equipping, not as a competing object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the bi phrase as the governed prepositional complement of the outfitting verb.

topics.headline: preposition turns root echo into a governed phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root echo is grammatically hinged by a preposition, making the opening phrase tighter.
topics.reason: The proclitic attaches directly to the noun and mediates the verb-noun repetition.

words.gloss_range: their travel equipment, governed by bi and marked by a plural possessive suffix
words.root_gloss_range: complete equipment or apparatus for travel and transition; broader trousseau/burial fields are narrowed to transition-kit pressure
words.prose: {{ar:جَهَازِهِمْ}} ({{tr:jahāzihim}}) names the brothers’ own equipment as a possessed travel kit. That matters because the cup is inserted into a domain already marked as theirs; the noun completes the cognate provisioning frame and reprises the earlier 12:59 equipment phrase, while the variant vowel does not change the referent.

topics.headline: governed noun and possessive suffix mark the equipment as theirs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the later hidden object enters equipment grammatically marked as belonging to the brothers.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under bi and bears the plural possessive suffix.

topics.headline: complete transition kit, locally travel gear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses a complete transition kit, while local context keeps the selected sense at travel equipment.
topics.reason: V4 supports broader equipment domains, but the local prepositional phrase and travel scene select the travel-kit branch.

topics.headline: jihaz variant preserves the equipment referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register recitational vowel texture without changing the local object being discussed.
topics.reason: The row is useful as apparatus, but the variant does not relocate the local mechanism away from equipment.

topics.headline: rare equipment noun completes the 12:59 reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the equipment noun finish the repeated-root opening and link this scene back to 12:59.
topics.reason: The noun is low occurrence, collocates with the same root verb, and repeats the earlier Joseph-scene equipment frame.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form I placement/configuration verb taking the cup as object and a locative complement
words.root_gloss_range: broad making/placing/appointing range; locally narrowed to deliberate placement/configuration in a container
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) is the main response to the temporal frame: Yusuf, still implicit, deliberately configures the cup into his brother’s saddlebag. The word is broader than simple depositing, but the local object-plus-locative frame narrows it to staged placement that pivots the ayah from provision to accusation and echoes the earlier bag scene in 12:62; wider configuration parallels (10:87), (25:35), and (7:150) remain comparative rather than controlling.

topics.headline: object plus locative complement answers the lamma frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the main action as the placement of one object into a specified container after the completed provisioning.
topics.reason: The local frame is direct object plus locative complement; the row calling it double-object is narrowed because the second element is a fi phrase, not a second direct object.

topics.headline: placing becomes deliberate configuration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act configures the scene for discovery, not merely that an item was set down.
topics.reason: The broad jaʿala range is narrowed by the explicit object and locative container, while the contrast with the intensive provisioning verb sharpens the simple decisive placement.

topics.headline: hidden-object placement reprises and reverses 12:62
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the earlier hidden-goods scene (12:62) reversed into a narrower hidden-cup scene, with later finding already prepared.
topics.reason: The same-surah evidence links jaʿala with bag placement scenes; this ayah narrows the earlier plural bag motif to one brother.

topics.headline: central covert action separates provision from proclamation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s private act sitting between two public-facing actions: provisioning and proclamation.
topics.reason: The clause sequence places jaʿala between the temporal provisioning frame and the later announcement frame.

topics.headline: broader plot-placement comparisons remain illustrative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare Quranic jaʿala configurations without letting distant examples govern this local bag placement.
topics.reason: The cited cross-Quran parallels are too broad to define the local sense, but they can remain as limited comparison for deliberate configuration.

words.gloss_range: definite gerund-like noun concretized as the placed cup or drinking/measuring vessel
words.root_gloss_range: watering/drinking/provisioning field; locally the act-name functions as an institutional vessel
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسِّقَايَةَ}} ({{tr:al-siqāyata}}) is not a generic object: a definite act-name from the watering field has become the concrete vessel placed into the bag. That gives the hidden cup institutional weight, linking service, measure, and accusation; the rare form also looks toward the watering-office field in 9:19 while staying local to the Joseph vessel scene, and a safina variant would alter the hidden object without governing the canonical wording.

topics.headline: definite act-name functions as concrete object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the placed item as a definite vessel whose morphology still remembers the act of watering.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, accusative as object of jaʿala, and a gerund form functioning concretely.

topics.headline: watering service resonance gives the cup institutional weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cup carries service and administrative resonance, while the local referent remains the planted vessel.
topics.reason: The watering-office field and 9:19 echo are real, but local syntax makes this the direct object vessel in the placement clause.

topics.headline: rare form connects vessel to Joseph cupbearer vocabulary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the planted vessel as part of a small but active water/service vocabulary field around the Joseph story.
topics.reason: The form is low occurrence and belongs to the broader s-q-y field, with same-surah cupbearer resonance.

topics.headline: safina variant is apparatus, not the canonical object here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can note that a variant changes the hidden object, while the canonical local analysis remains the definite vessel.
topics.reason: The row is preserved as variant apparatus; it does not govern the canonical local parse.

topics.headline: the cup is the covert clause center and accusation trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah’s concealed action centers on this vessel before it is later renamed as the missing measure.
topics.reason: The direct object bridges jaʿala to the container phrase and supplies the object around which later accusation develops.

words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) narrows the placement to inside the brother’s travel container. It is the small hinge of concealment: the cup is not merely near the bag or associated with it, but located within it.

topics.headline: fi selects interior containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the accusation mechanism depend on containment inside the bag, not mere proximity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the fi phrase as the locative complement of the placement verb.

topics.headline: preposition links object to container without apposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that concealment is grammatically built by a prepositional link between cup and container.
topics.reason: The preposition mediates the relation between the placed object and rahl as container.

words.gloss_range: singular construct travel container or saddlebag governed by fi
words.root_gloss_range: travel gear, saddle, pack, or baggage field; locally narrowed to one brother’s travel container
words.prose: {{ar:رَحْلِ}} ({{tr:raḥli}}) makes the place of concealment a singular travel container in construct with the brother. The cup enters not a public store of goods but one personal saddlebag, a rare Joseph-scene container word that echoes the earlier bags in 12:62 and anticipates the search formula in 12:76; a rijl variant would move the location, but the canonical wording keeps the cup in the travel container.

topics.headline: fi-governed construct names one container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the narrowing from group equipment to one brother’s specific container.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by fi and stands in construct with the following brother noun.

topics.headline: travel-pack image makes the evidence space intimate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the accusation forming inside a private travel space, while the local sense remains a travel container.
topics.reason: Lexical evidence supports saddlebag/travel-pack pressure; local syntax uses it as the container of the planted vessel.

topics.headline: rijl variant remains apparatus only
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can note that a variant would alter the location, while the canonical local wording keeps the cup in the travel container.
topics.reason: The variant row is useful for apparatus but does not override the canonical container parse.

topics.headline: rare container word links 12:62 and 12:76
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this saddlebag as part of a same-surah chain from hidden goods (12:62) to the searched bag (12:76).
topics.reason: The contextual evidence marks the noun as low occurrence and clustered in Joseph travel-container scenes.

topics.headline: container completes the hidden-placement clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the locative phrase as the point where the covert action becomes evidentiary.
topics.reason: The container phrase completes the placement clause before the narrative turns to public proclamation.

words.gloss_range: his brother in genitive construct relation with a possessive suffix anchored to Yusuf
words.root_gloss_range: literal brotherhood and close kin relation; locally the targeted brother is Yusuf’s brother Benjamin
words.prose: {{ar:أَخِيهِ}} ({{tr:akhīhi}}) lands the hidden object on Yusuf’s brother, not on the caravan in general. The five-noun construct and suffix make the bag a kinship-marked target: the private disclosure of brotherhood in 12:69 has become the public-risk location for the accusation, and later theft language will turn back toward a brother in 12:77.

topics.headline: construct and suffix identify Yusuf as relational anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the planted object land in one kinship-marked bag, specifically Benjamin’s in relation to Yusuf.
topics.reason: The noun completes the construct, the suffix supplies the possessor relation, and contextual support identifies Yusuf as the relational anchor.

topics.headline: literal brotherhood carries closeness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reversal from intimate brotherly closeness to a targeted container, while local grammar keeps literal brotherhood primary.
topics.reason: Root-dispute and closeness evidence can color the kinship relation, but the local construct selects the literal brother.

topics.headline: brother target anticipates 12:77 deflection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brother whose bag receives the cup becomes the pressure point for later brother-theft speech in 12:77.
topics.reason: The same-surah echo connects the planted brother’s bag with later speech about a brother stealing.

topics.headline: brother co-occurs with placement, provisioning, and theft roots
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees brotherhood as the relational spine tying provisioning, placement, and accusation together.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows are distributional but cohere with the local sequence around the brother’s bag.

words.gloss_range: sequencing conjunction marking interval or distinct next stage
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) keeps the private placement and the public proclamation from collapsing into one immediate beat. The ayah moves after a marked interval or distinction from hidden action to public voice.

topics.headline: thumma marks sequence with distinction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the announcement is a distinct next stage after the concealed placement.
topics.reason: The conjunction opens the next verbal clause and is not an event word; its local force is sequence with separation.

topics.headline: pivot from concealment to public stage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the narrative shift from hidden arrangement to staged public accusation.
topics.reason: The clause after thumma introduces the proclamation and direct addressee.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form II proclamation verb introducing a public speech event
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, announcing, authorizing field; locally public proclamation rather than mere notice
words.prose: {{ar:أَذَّنَ}} ({{tr:adhdhana}}) turns the hidden placement into a formal audible event. The verb opens a public proclamation whose herald is named separately and whose quoted content follows; its Form II force and same-root agent make the accusation sound institutionally broadcast rather than casually reported, while proclamation or permission parallels (9:3), (2:249), (10:100), and (12:80) remain comparative.

topics.headline: proclamation verb opens public speech event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is staged as a public speech event carried by a herald, not narrated directly by Yusuf.
topics.reason: The verb has an explicit postverbal subject and takes the later quoted accusation as its speech content.

topics.headline: Form II makes notice a formal broadcast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the shift from hidden placement to formal proclamation with public auditory force.
topics.reason: The Form II proclamation branch fits the local public announcement and should not be flattened to a bare notice.

topics.headline: same-root verb and herald enact public calling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the act of announcing immediately embodied in an announcer.
topics.reason: The following active participle subject repeats the same root and shifts it from act to agent.

topics.headline: broader proclamation field supplies contrast only
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place this human herald beside other proclamation or permission scenes, while the local parse remains Joseph-story public accusation.
topics.reason: The root is low occurrence in this form, but divine and permission parallels are comparative rather than controlling the local sense.

words.gloss_range: indefinite Form II active participle functioning as subject: a herald/announcer
words.root_gloss_range: announcing or making heard; locally an official herald role rather than a named person
words.prose: {{ar:مُؤَذِّنٌ}} ({{tr:muʾadhdhinun}}) names an indefinite herald after the proclamation verb. The grammar foregrounds the role and public function more than personal identity: the accusation passes through an official-sounding voice, the repeated root makes proclamation audible as both action and agent, and the rare herald form has 7:44 as a comparison without importing that scene.

topics.headline: postverbal indefinite herald supplies the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the public voice carried by a role, not by a named accuser.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the active participle the subject of the proclamation verb; indefiniteness keeps the office foregrounded.

topics.headline: agent noun gives the accusation institutional voice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the charge as an official broadcast rather than private speech.
topics.reason: The Form II active participle names the one who publicly announces.

topics.headline: announcer repeats the announcement root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root turning from proclamation into proclaimer within one clause.
topics.reason: The verb-agent sequence is an immediate same-root echo.

topics.headline: rare herald form pairs with 7:44 only as comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register the form’s rarity and its 7:44 proclamation parallel without importing that scene into this one.
topics.reason: The form is rare, but the 7:44 contrast is comparative and does not govern the Joseph-scene herald.

words.gloss_range: formal feminine vocative particle introducing the addressee phrase
words.prose: {{ar:أَيَّتُهَا}} ({{tr:ayyatuhā}}) opens the direct public address and agrees with the collective caravan term that follows. It raises the scene from narration to formal summons before the emphatic accusation lands.

topics.headline: feminine vocative agrees with collective addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a formal attention call shaped to the collective addressee.
topics.reason: The vocative particle introduces the addressee phrase and its feminine shape fits the following collective noun.

topics.headline: vocative pivots from herald frame to accused audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the proclamation prepare an audience before asserting the theft label.
topics.reason: The addressee phrase stands before the quoted emphatic content.

words.gloss_range: definite collective caravan or provision convoy addressed in vocative apposition
words.root_gloss_range: broad root has many branches; locally the provision-caravan branch is selected, not donkey, reproach, calibration, or other branches
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿīru}}) hails the whole loaded caravan as the public audience of the charge. The word compresses people, animals, and goods into one definite convoy, then the following plural pronoun turns that collective into accused persons; its rare Surah 12 recurrence lets the same caravan remain available as witness in 12:82 and as a different emotional signal in 12:94.

topics.headline: definite collective caravan feeds plural accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a collective convoy label becomes a group of directly accused people.
topics.reason: The noun specifies the vocative addressee and feeds the following second-person plural accusation.

topics.headline: trade-and-load convoy branch is selected locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the address to a caravan spatially fits a missing object and baggage scene, while unrelated root branches stay inactive.
topics.reason: V4 lists many ʿ-y-r branches, but the local appositional vocative in a travel-goods scene selects the provision-convoy sense.

topics.headline: caravan recurs as witness and recognition signal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this accused convoy as the same narrative term that can later be appealed to in 12:82 and reappear at departure in 12:94.
topics.reason: The occurrence evidence confines the term to the Joseph narrative and links the present address with later caravan references.

topics.headline: vocative creates the audience before the theft predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the address forming the public audience before the sharp accusation label lands.
topics.reason: The noun sits between the vocative marker and the emphatic accusation clause.

words.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle fused with second-person plural suffix
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:innakum}}) begins the quoted accusation with assertion already fused to the addressees. The caravan just hailed as a collective is now addressed as plural persons, so the private singular reassurance of 12:69 has reversed into a public plural charge, and the clause moves toward a double-emphatic identity label.

topics.headline: inna binds assertion to plural accused persons
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears certainty and direct plural address arrive together at the start of the accusation.
topics.reason: The particle opens the quoted complement and the suffix is the plural addressee complement of inna.

topics.headline: inna opens the stacked-emphasis climax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees all prior narrative beats resolve into a grammatically maximal accusation.
topics.reason: The inna clause combines with the following emphatic lam before the predicate.

topics.headline: private singular intimacy reverses into public plural charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from private singular reassurance in 12:69 to public plural accusation in 12:70.
topics.reason: The boundary rows cohere with the pronoun shift from Benjamin individually to the caravan group collectively.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lam proclitic on the predicate of the inna clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle with second-person plural suffix

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) carries the assertion from {{ar:إِنَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:innakum}}) onto the theft predicate. It does not add a new referent; it makes the final identity label arrive as certified rather than tentative.

topics.headline: emphatic lam certifies the theft predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the theft label delivered under a second formal emphasis.
topics.reason: The lam is attached to the predicate active participle and completes the inna-plus-lam emphatic frame.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural active participle functioning as the emphatic predicate: thieves
words.root_gloss_range: covert unauthorized taking/theft field; locally an identity accusation against the addressed caravan, not a report of one completed act
words.prose: {{ar:سَارِقُونَ}} ({{tr:sāriqūna}}) is the ayah’s final landing: an indefinite plural active participle classifies the addressed caravan as thieves. Because the cup was just hidden by another agent, the word carries moral accusation, covert-taking imagery, and structural irony; it also opens a same-surah theft vocabulary chain that returns in 12:73, 12:77, and 12:81, while legal-theft parallels such as 5:38 remain comparative rather than determinative here.

topics.headline: active participle classifies the group as thieves
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation assigns an identity to the group rather than merely reporting a past act.
topics.reason: The word is a nominative active participle predicate under inna and lam, masculine plural to match the addressees.

topics.headline: covert-taking label answers a hidden placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that a concealed placement by one agent becomes a public covert-taking label for another group.
topics.reason: The theft sense is locally active, and the ayah structure separates the placer from the accused class.

topics.headline: final word makes the accusation the take-away
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close on the identity accusation, which immediately generates the next ayah’s question about what is missing.
topics.reason: The predicate is final in the ayah and completes the stacked emphatic quotation.

topics.headline: same-surah theft vocabulary begins here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this final label seed the theft vocabulary that returns in the brothers’ later speech, especially 12:77.
topics.reason: Same-surah evidence clusters s-r-q around the accusation and defense sequence.

topics.headline: 5:38 theft field is comparative, not controlling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register the shared theft-participle field with 5:38 while keeping 12:70 inside a staged narrative accusation.
topics.reason: The legal theft participles in 5:38 are relevant for lexical field contrast, but the local context is not a legal ruling and should not infer Benjamin’s legal liability.

topics.headline: claim that s-r-q occurs only in Surah 12 is contradicted
topics.blocking_evidence: Supplied evidence includes 5:38 and a root count beyond Surah 12, contradicting the exclusivity claim.
topics.reason: The row says the root is absent outside Surah 12, but other supplied rows cite 5:38 and the contextual profile gives a broader count.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from provisioning, through placing the watering vessel in the brother's travel effects, to the herald's collective theft charge.
baseline_models.mechanism: A controlled loading operation gives the planted object an ordinary service identity and a private possession-space; the public call then converts that manufactured location into group liability.

activation_trace.role: Portable prepared equipment grounds the opening as a deliberate loading operation and supplies camouflage for the planted object.
Causing something to occupy a new state makes the object's relocation the causal hinge of the scene.
The service of giving drink lends the vessel an innocent public function that can be converted into evidence.
Portable lodging and personal effects provide the private possession-space in which apparent custody is manufactured.
Literal brotherhood makes the selected baggage relationally specific rather than an arbitrary hiding place.
Public notification by a herald turns a hidden placement into a socially operative claim.
The provision-bearing caravan makes the accusation collective and gives the herald a moving group to stop.
The act of attributing theft marks the final clause as an imputation performed upon the caravan.

changed_reading.before: After travelers are supplied, a missing vessel is noticed and they are accused of stealing it.
changed_reading.after: The focus itself reads as an engineered stop: provisioning supplies camouflage and a carrier, private placement manufactures the apparent fact, and public announcement converts that fact into collective liability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The material assignment expressed by the placement verb is followed by a public address whose predicate labels the entire caravan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The scene performs two assignments in series: an object is assigned to a location, then a social and potentially legal status is assigned to a group. The accusation is therefore an operation, not only a report.

activation_trace.role: The saying and naming extension lets material assignment echo as a second, verbal assignment of status.
A formally broadcast notice gives the assigned status public reach and procedural force.
Reproach and public shame make the caravan address reputationally consequential rather than neutrally descriptive.
Attribution to theft supplies the exact speech act by which the group is recoded.

changed_reading.before: The herald reports an already established theft.
changed_reading.after: The herald's sentence publicly manufactures the caravan's operative identity as thieves, paralleling the prior manufacture of the object's apparent location.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vessel is placed specifically in a brother's travel gear before the moving caravan is halted by a collective call.
baseline_models.mechanism: Travel gear normally enables departure, but the planted object makes that gear a point of attachment. A latent tether within the kinship root and hidden-departure branches within the accusation convert mobility into restraint.

activation_trace.role: Movement toward a destination makes the baggage an instrument of mobility before it becomes an anchor.
The bond or tether extension turns brotherhood into a concrete image of attachment at the selected bag.
Going, roaming, and slipping away give the addressed caravan an active mobility that the accusation interrupts.
Secret withdrawal makes the theft lexeme carry a second danger, departure, which the public cry forecloses.

changed_reading.before: The brother's bag is merely a convenient place to conceal evidence.
changed_reading.after: The brother's travel apparatus is converted into a tether: the very equipment of departure becomes the point through which kin and caravan can be held.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus repeats an earlier hidden-placement grammar but reverses its semiotic output. Merchandise placed in baggage becomes a benevolent sign that is found, recognized, and returned; the vessel placed in one brother's baggage becomes an incriminating sign that converts discovery into accusation and retention.

activation_trace.role: Recognition from an identifying trace establishes signs and their readers as an active mechanism in the episode.
Nonrecognition establishes the initial asymmetry in who can interpret persons and signs.
The earlier causing of goods to occupy baggage supplies a structurally matched hidden placement.
Personal travel effects form the same possession-space used by the focus's second placement.
Recognition through a trace gives the first concealed object an explicit future-facing purpose.
Finding the returned goods demonstrates that concealed placement can reliably generate a later discovery.
Return to the prior owner makes the first sign benevolent and return-producing.
The focus repeats the state-changing placement while changing the object, owner, and consequence.
The second placement culminates in attributed guilt rather than recognized generosity.

structural_cues: 12:62 and 12:70 repeat a make-or-place plus object plus baggage construction; the first uses their merchandise and their bags, while the second uses the watering vessel and the brother's bag.
The first hidden object is found and returned in 12:65; the focus immediately supplies a second hidden object followed by a public charge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two concealed placements and the first one's recognition-return cycle; I infer that the second deliberately reverses the sign's function from gift to evidence. A live alternative is that the two placements are parallel tactics without a designed semiotic contrast.

changed_reading.before: The hidden vessel simply manufactures incriminating possession.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the dark second pass through an established sign-machine: the first baggage insertion invites recognition and return, while the second redirects recognition into accusation and retention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated food measurement is conditioned on bringing the brother; after the focus, the planted vessel is identified as a sovereign measuring cup, paired with a camel-load reward, and used in a penalty that lets the found person stand as recompense. The object becomes a conversion token between provisions, authority, and a body.

activation_trace.role: Measured food establishes the quantitative exchange system in which access depends on producing the brother.
Comparison between quantities lets the added brother and a camel's measure become commensurable terms in the family's argument.
The named missing object is both container and measuring unit, joining the focus's vessel to the prior measure economy.
A visible carried load supplies the reward-equivalent offered for restoring the missing measure.
Sovereign authority makes the measuring vessel institutionally charged rather than merely valuable household property.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the decisive conversion from recovered object to retained person.
An allotted share and its channel let the watering vessel carry the logic of controlled distribution into the trap.
Calibration of measure makes the addressed caravan the domain in which standards, loads, and liability are compared.

structural_cues: In 12:59-60 the brother is the condition for receiving measure, and in 12:65 his presence is argued as an added camel measure.
After the focus, the vessel is called a measuring cup in 12:72 and the person in whose baggage it is found becomes the penalty in 12:75.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated measure, a sovereign measuring vessel, a load reward, and a substitutionary penalty; I infer a conversion chain from food quantity through proof-object to person. The live alternative is that the cup is only a convenient identifiable object and the quantitative echoes are incidental.

changed_reading.before: The planted cup is a valuable object used to stop the caravan.
changed_reading.after: The cup is a conversion device: a standard from the provisioning system is moved into the brother's bag so that measured food, royal property, a camel load, and finally the brother's person can be exchanged across one procedure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers promise guarded return under a binding pledge except when they are surrounded. They enter in dispersed formation, but the focus addresses them again as one caravan and creates a stop centered on one brother's bag. The accusation can therefore be read as constructing the spatial exception to their pledge.

activation_trace.role: The brothers' promise of active guarding establishes safe return as their assumed human task.
A confirmed covenant formalizes the duty to bring the brother back.
Literal surrounding supplies the expressly stated topology in which the return obligation can fail.
Entry by dispersed routes initially resists collective enclosure, making the later single caravan address a reversal.
Entrusting the affair elsewhere prevents the human pledge from exhausting the scene's account of custody.
The collective caravan address regathers the previously dispersed entrants into one stoppable body.
The tether extension concentrates the collective stop at the one brother whose return the pledge secures.

structural_cues: 12:66 makes being surrounded the sole stated exception to returning the brother.
12:67 disperses the brothers across gates, whereas 12:70 hails them collectively and locates the triggering object in only one brother's travel effects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the enclosure exception, dispersed entry, collective hail, and brother-specific placement; I infer that the accusation realizes the exception's spatial form. A live alternative is that being surrounded denotes only overwhelming external disaster and has no designed link to this stop.

changed_reading.before: The theft charge halts the caravan and singles out the brother.
changed_reading.after: The halt also resembles an engineered enclosure: it regathers the dispersed group and creates the one condition under which their pledged control over the brother's return gives way.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition is asymmetrical from the start, and immediately before the focus the brother is privately gathered in and told the speaker's fraternal identity. The next speech is delegated to an indefinite herald and addresses the group through an accusation. Private kinship truth and public procedural speech are deliberately partitioned.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by distinguishing signs gives one party privileged knowledge of identity.
The others' nonrecognition preserves an information gap that can support different private and public messages.
Drawing the brother into a sheltering proximity creates the protected inside of the information partition.
Brotherhood remains the concealed relational truth at the exact site of the planted object.
Delegated public announcement constructs the outside channel through which a different operative message travels.
Attribution to theft supplies the public status without disclosing the protected identity relation.

structural_cues: 12:69 uses first-person private identification to the singular brother; 12:70 shifts to an indefinite herald and a plural public address.
The object is placed in the baggage of the same person who has just been privately told the hidden identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asymmetric recognition, private shelter and identification, then delegated public accusation; I infer a controlled partition between protected truth and usable public speech. A live alternative is simple juxtaposition, with delegation serving only ordinary administration.

changed_reading.before: The announcement exposes the consequence of a concealed material act.
changed_reading.after: The announcement also conceals while exposing: it broadcasts an operative accusation to the group while keeping the immediately prior truth of brotherhood inside a protected dyad.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus opens a ratcheting elicitation procedure. The stopped group asks what is missing, hears a specified claim and guarantee, asserts innocence, is asked to state the penalty, and authors a rule under which the person possessing the object becomes recompense. A staged search then realizes that rule, while the packet explicitly says direct taking under the sovereign's law was unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Requesting the absent thing opens the interrogative sequence rather than immediately fixing a penalty.
A specific cup and measure gives the accusation a concrete, searchable token.
An assumed guarantee attaches enforceable commitment to the public recovery claim.
The demand to match act with consequence transfers attention from factual denial to rule selection.
Substitution lets the person in possession stand in place of the object's penalty.
Finding supplies the evidentiary condition chosen by the brothers' own formula.
Personal travel effects define the possession-space on which the stated penalty turns.
Putting a thing in the wrong place makes the punitive formula uncannily mirror the trap's manufactured misplacement.
Beginning with the other containers turns search order into procedural camouflage.
Physical containment localizes the proof and permits a staged progression from bag to bag.
Drawing the object out of concealment converts private placement into publicly disclosed proof.
The explicit stratagem branch identifies the search-and-rule sequence as designed rather than accidental.
Capture and detention state the legal effect that the procedure must make available.
A regime of accounting and consequence marks the jurisdiction whose available penalty is at issue.
Sovereign authority names the legal order under which direct detention could not be obtained.
The focus's state-changing placement supplies the fact pattern that the elicited rule will later consume.
The public call initiates the exchange through which the other party is induced to formulate its own consequence.
Attribution of theft supplies the charged category that prompts denial, penalty inquiry, and search.

structural_cues: 12:71-75 forms a ratchet: missing-object question, specified claim and guarantee, innocence assertion, penalty question, then the caravan's own penalty formula.
12:76 searches the other containers first, extracts the object from the brother's container, calls the sequence a stratagem, and states that direct taking under the sovereign's law was unavailable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the complete dialogue, ordered search, explicit stratagem, and legal constraint; I infer that the focus's heralding is designed to elicit a usable foreign penalty rather than merely announce loss. A live alternative is that some procedural steps are opportunistic responses after the initial stop.

changed_reading.before: Manufactured apparent possession supports a theft accusation and detention.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the opening move of a jurisdiction switch: its public charge induces the caravan to author the penalty under which the planted vessel licenses the brother's detention where the sovereign's own law would not.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it follows the non-dominant mapped target of the watering-vessel occurrence into driving and marketplace branches. It remains anchored by the packet's explicit split mapping, the focus's provisioning cargo, and its addressed caravan; downstream prose should present it as a cross-root activation, not as the surface word's lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The watering vessel sits between completed provisioning and the public stoppage of a provision-bearing caravan.

activation_trace.role: Driving and impelling turn the planted vessel into a switch that redirects the moving group.
The marketplace extension links the vessel to the exchange system from which the caravan has just been provisioned.
Following in a single sequence models the convoy's controlled movement and the procedural steps that follow the call.
Prepared portable cargo supplies the concrete logistics on which the redirection acts.
A caravan bearing provisions is the moving commercial body shifted from route to custody.
The offered camel load keeps cargo movement and exchange active after the stop.

changed_reading.before: A cup is planted in commercial cargo as evidence.
changed_reading.after: The vessel acts like a logistics switch within a market flow, driving the provision-bearing convoy out of ordinary circulation and into a controlled legal sequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it pairs material containers with hearing and mental containment, and because covert listening is distant from the surface accusation. It remains anchored in the bag, herald, theft root, and the later repeated container root; downstream prose should qualify it as a structural echo rather than a claim that the nouns are synonyms.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A hidden vessel in travel effects is followed by a heralded sentence that must enter collective hearing.

activation_trace.role: Portable personal effects provide the first enclosure, the material container of the planted proof.
The ear and vessel-handle extension joins bodily reception to the handled object at the center of the call.
Listening and accepting what is heard provide the second enclosure, the audience's uptake of the accusation.
Covert hearing lets concealment migrate from the material act into the informational register.
Holding meaning in the mind supplies an informational counterpart to holding an object in a bag.
Holding an object in a container supplies the material half of the same containment pair.

changed_reading.before: One object is hidden in one bag and a subsequent accusation is heard.
changed_reading.after: The scene runs two containment-and-release operations in parallel: proof is enclosed in baggage and extracted, while accusatory meaning is broadcast into listeners and made socially operative.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surface plainly denotes equipping, while the cited branch carries the distant image of finishing a wounded being. It remains anchored by the repeated provisioning root and is activated by the later explicit stratagem and capture; downstream prose should call it a dark branch resonance, never a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated provisioning root opens the same sentence whose concealed placement and accusation close off the caravan's departure.

activation_trace.role: The finishing-stroke extension recasts completed provisioning as the action that completes an already prepared capture.
Loading another with harm makes the brother's travel gear the medium through which the trap is imposed.
Attribution of theft supplies the closing social blow that makes the planted object actionable.
The later naming of a stratagem activates the sense that the opening logistics were designed toward a terminal effect.
Capture and detention identify the terminal effect toward which the branch resonance points.

changed_reading.before: Provisioning merely disguises a trap that follows.
changed_reading.after: At branch level, the provisioning itself is the finishing motion of the trap: loading, harmful burden, public imputation, and capture form one completed operation.

strongest_changes: The focus reverses the earlier baggage-sign pattern from recognition and return into accusation and retention.
The measuring vessel converts a provisioning quantity into royal evidence and finally into a person-valued penalty.
Private recognition and brotherhood are partitioned from the public status created by the herald's accusation.
The announcement initiates an elicited jurisdictional procedure that makes detention possible under the caravan's own stated rule.
summary.what_was_special: The focus coordinates cargo, container, kinship, measurement, speech, and law without collapsing them into one reading. Its most unusual activations are the non-dominant market-and-driving target, the parallel containment of object and message, and the dark finishing-stroke resonance within provisioning.
remaining_uncertainties: The measure-to-person conversion may be a designed mechanism or an especially coherent material coincidence.
The pledge's enclosure exception may anticipate the stop, or only acquire that shape retrospectively.
The market-drive, double-container, and finishing-stroke readings remain branch-distant and should stay explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A public accusation is manufactured from a privately placed vessel.** س ق ي B001/B002 supplies the drinking implement, ر ح ل B004 the baggage container, ء ذ ن B003 (public notification), ع ي ر B007 (provision caravan), and س ر ق B005 (accusing someone of theft) create a concealment-to-announcement reversal. I infer that placement is designed to make the later charge materially searchable.
2. **Kinship and office operate on different visibility levels.** The cup is put specifically in `رحل أخيه` after private brotherly recognition, while the caravan is addressed collectively. I infer that Yusuf separates the protected person from the public procedure without yet disclosing the kin relation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:76 named the whole procedure as a stratagem for Yusuf and disclosed its legal purpose: retaining his brother under their own sanction.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A hospitality instrument repurposed into public evidence.** `س ق ي:B001` is giving drink or water; *al-siqāyah* anchors that provisioning function in the fixed ayah. The vessel is placed in the brother’s pack after the group is equipped, then an announcement converts hidden placement into a theft accusation; 12:72 names it the king’s cup and 12:76 stages its recovery. The packet supplies the object’s two roles; I infer that its ordinary public ownership makes its secret relocation capable of supporting the charge. The ayah reads as deliberate functional reversal from service-object to evidentiary trigger.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:76 draws the vessel from the brother's container and states the plan's enabling logic, confirming that an ordinary drinking object had been reassigned a temporary but exact evidentiary function.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli bir ihtiyaç için önceden hazırlanıp bir araya getirilen eşya ve gereçleri merkeze alır. Ev, yolculuk, gelin, cenaze ve ordu bağlamları bu ortak çekirdeğin uygulamalarıdır; hazırlama, taşıma ve gönderme ise aynı eşya kümesine yönelik işlemlerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir ev, yolculuk, gelin, cenaze ya da ordu gibi belirli bir ihtiyaç için önceden hazırlanıp bir araya getirilen eşya ve gereçler bütünüdür. Türemiş kullanımlarda bu bütünü hazırlama, sağlama, taşıma veya gönderme eylemini de anlatır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir ihtiyacı karşılamak üzere hazırlanmış eşya ve gereçlerden oluşan bir bütündür.
Ev, yolculuk, gelin, cenaze ve ordu için gerekenler bu genel eşya bütününün bağlama göre özelleşmiş örnekleridir.
Aynı anlam alanı, gerekenleri hazırlama ve sağlama yanında onları taşıma ya da gönderme işlemlerine uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, amaç için hazırlanmış eşya ve gereçler çekirdeğinde birleşir; bağlama göre ev, yol, evlilik, cenaze ve askerlik ihtiyaçlarını, eylem düzeyinde ise hazırlama, taşıma veya gönderme işlemlerini belirtir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الجِهاز متاع البيت (maqayis;jamhara)؛ تكلفت جِهاز سفره (maqayis)؛ جهزت القوم تجهيزا إذا تكلفت لهم جِهازهم للسفر وكذلك جِهاز العروس والميت (ayn;tahdhib)؛ جِهاز العروس وجِهاز السفر وجهزت العروس وجهزت الجيش (sihah)؛ الجِهاز ما يعد من متاع وغيره والتجهيز حمل ذلك أو بعثه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca öldürme sonucunu değil, zaten yaralı olan birinin öldürülmesini hızla kesinleştirme ve tamamlama eylemini bildirir. Bu nedenle yaralılık, etkin bir öldüren özne ve tamamlayıcı son hamle anlamın kurucu sınırlarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel öldürme ya da kendiliğinden ölüm değildir; yaralı birini hızla öldürüp eylemi tamamlayan bağlı kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, yaralı birine yönelen belirli söz öbeğine bağlıdır; çıplak köke genel bir öldürme anlamı olarak yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Zaten yaralı olan birini hızla öldürerek öldürme eylemini kesin sonuca ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Eylemin hedefi önceden yaralanmış ve yaşamaya devam eden bir varlıktır.
Öldüren özne, son eylemi hızla uygulayıp ölümü kesinleştirir ve öldürmeyi tamamlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, yaralı birini öldürme konusunda birleşir; daha ayrıntılı anlatım bunun hızlı bir son hamleyle ölümü kesinleştirip öldürmeyi tamamlamak olduğunu belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Önceden yaralanmış bir hedefin etkin bir son eylemle öldürüldüğü ve öldürmenin tamamlandığı bağlı kullanımın tamamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yaralı hedef, etkin öldürme, hız ve tamamlayıcı sonuç birlikte korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlamın ölümcül son eylemi açıkça gösterdiği anlatılarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaralı hedefe son darbeyi indirip öldürmeyi tamamlama anlamı bağlam içinde korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hedefin önceden yaralı olduğu çevre metinden anlaşıldığında tamamlayıcı öldürme eylemini açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Öldürmeyi tamamlayan etkin son hamle korunur.
error_profile.loses: Yaralı hedef koşulu söz öbeğinin kendi içinde açıkça belirtilmez.

error_profile.preserves: Bir öznenin başka bir varlığın yaşamına son vermesi korunur.
error_profile.adds: Yaralı olmayan hedefleri ve tamamlayıcı son hamle niteliği taşımayan her türlü öldürmeyi kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Önceden yaralanmış bir hedefin hızla öldürülmesini ve öldürmenin tamamlanmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Canlı bir hayvanın kesilmesini ve kesimin yaşamı sona erdirecek ölçüde tamamlanmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de yaşam sürerken başlamış ölümcül bir işlemin sonuca ulaştırılması vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yaralı hedefe yönelik genel bir son öldürme eylemidir; komşu dal hayvan kesimi usulüne ve kesimin tamamlanmasına bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir öznenin yaralı hedefi etkin biçimde öldürüp eylemi tamamlaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ölümün bir öldüren özne veya önceki yaralanma şartı olmadan hızlı gerçekleşmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ölümün kısa sürede gerçekleşmesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal katılımcıları ve tamamlayıcı eylemi zorunlu kılar; komşu dal ise ölüm olayının hızını niteler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Zaten yaralı olan hedefe uygulanan ve ölümü tamamlayan son eylem.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dövmenin kendi başına öldürücü sonuca ulaşması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal etkin bir şiddet eylemiyle ölüm sonucuna ulaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal önceki yaralanma ve tamamlama aşamasına bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise öldürücü dövme biçimidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yaralı hedefe son eylemle ölümü kesinleştirme.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hedefi suya batırarak öldürme ve buradan gelişen genel öldürme kullanımı.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: son darbeyle öldürme ile boğarak öldürme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir öznenin başka bir varlığı öldürmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal eylemin aşamasını ve hedefin yaralı durumunu, komşu dal ise öldürme aracını ve yöntemini belirler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar incelendi; yaralılık, tamamlama aşaması, etkin özne ve öldürme yöntemi sınırlarını açıklayan dört komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: الإجهاز أو الجهز على الجريح بإسراع قتله وإتمامه
branches.what_is_not_ar: إعداد الجهاز؛ سرعة الفرس؛ موت وحي بلا فعل قتل
branches.source_phrase_ar: أجهزت على الجريح أثبت قتله (ayn)؛ جهزت على الجريح وأجهزت عليه إذا قتلته (jamhara)؛ أجهزت على الجريح إذا أسرعت قتله وقد تممت عليه (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın çizgisi, yüklü hayvanın ürküp kaçarken üstündeki eşya ve yükü dağıtması ve bu görüntünün uzaklaşma ya da dönmeme için deyimleşmesidir. Bununla birlikte tek aktarım aynı sözü hayvanın ölmesi için de verir; bu, ana çerçeveye eşitlenmemesi gereken bir kaynak değişkesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca belirtilen söz öbeğinde geçerlidir; somut kaçış, deyimsel uzaklaşma ve sınırlı ölüm aktarımı ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam belirli bir vurma ve yük söz öbeğine bağlıdır; buradan çıplak biçime genel kaçma, uzaklaşma veya ölme anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yüklü bir hayvanın ürküp kaçarken ayağına dolaşan veya üstündeki eşya ve yükü savurup atmasıdır; deyim yoluyla birinin ya da bir şeyin uzaklaşıp geri dönmemesini anlatır. Sınırlı bir aktarım aynı sözü hayvanın ölmesi için de kullanır.

facets.statement: Somut başlangıç görüntüsünde yüklü hayvan ürker, denetimden çıkar ve kaçar.
Kaçış sırasında eşya ayağına dolaşır veya üstündeki araç ve yük savrulup yere atılır.
Söz, somut görüntüden hareketle uzaklaşma, ayrılma ve geri dönmeme için deyimsel olarak kullanılır.
Sınırlı bir aktarım, aynı sözü yüklü hayvanın ölmesi anlamında da verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatı ürküp kaçan yüklü hayvan görüntüsünden hareket eder ve bunu uzaklaşma ya da dönmeme deyimine genişletir. Ayrıntılar yükün hayvanın ayağına dolaşması veya üstünden savrulması arasında değişir; ayrıca sınırlı bir aktarım ölüm anlamını ekler.

concept_gloss.text: yükünü atıp kaçma; dönmemecesine uzaklaşma, kimi aktarımda ölme
concept_gloss.applicability: Söz öbeğinin somut hayvan görüntüsünü, bundan doğan ayrılık anlamını ve sınırlı ölüm değişkesini birlikte gösteren açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ürkme, kaçış, yükün dağılması, deyimsel uzaklaşma ve sınırlı ölüm aktarımı korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yüklü hayvanın ürküp denetimden çıktığı ve üzerindeki eşyayı dağıttığı somut bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın kaçışı ve yükünü savurup atması korunur.
error_profile.loses: Deyimsel uzaklaşma ile sınırlı ölüm aktarımı bu somut karşılıkta yer almaz.

contextual_glosses.text: çekip gitmek ve bir daha dönmemek
contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi ya da şey için ayrılma, uzaklaşma ve geri dönmeme kastedildiğinde doğal bir deyim karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaklaşma ve geri dönmeme sonucu korunur.
error_profile.loses: Hayvanın ürkmesi, yükün dağılması ve ölüm değişkesi ifade edilmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yükünü dağıtarak ürküp kaçmak; deyim yoluyla uzaklaşıp dönmemek

error_profile.preserves: Denetimden çıkıp uzaklaşma hareketini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yükün dağılması, söz öbeğine bağlılık, geri dönmeme uzantısı ve ölüm değişkesi kaybolur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yüklü hayvanın kaçarken eşyasını dağıtması ve bundan doğan dönmeme deyimi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvanların yük taşıma şartı olmadan başıboş kaçması ve başka alanlara uzanan genel yayılma kullanımları.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yükünü atıp kaçma ile başıboş kaçma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın somut kesişimi, hayvanın denetimden çıkıp uzaklaşmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli söz öbeği içinde yükün savrulmasını ve deyimsel dönmemeyi taşır; komşu dal genel ürküp kaçma davranışını adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hazırlanmış eşyanın ürken hayvan tarafından savrulup atıldığı bir kaçış ve uzaklaşma anlatısı.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli bir ihtiyaç için hazırlanmış eşya ve gereçler bütünü ile bunların sağlanması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kaçan hayvanın taşıdığı eşya, iki dalı aynı somut sahnede buluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal eşyanın yer aldığı bir kaçış sözünü, komşu dal ise eşyanın kendisini ve hazırlanmasını anlatır; anlam çekirdekleri farklıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yüklü hayvanın ürkmesi ve yükünü savurarak kaçması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yükün iki yanından biri ve hayvanın iki yanındaki dolu yük dengesi.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yükü savurup kaçma ile yükün bir yanı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yük taşıyan hayvan ve üzerindeki eşya sahnesiyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hareketli bir kaçış olayını, komşu dal ise yükün konumunu ve yanlardan birini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm aday kartlar değerlendirildi; genel ürküp kaçma ile iki yük ve eşya komşusu, söz öbeğinin somut ve deyimsel sınırını açıklamak üzere seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: المثل في البعير إذا شرد أو جفل فطرح أداته وحمله ثم ذهب، وفي الهجران والتباعد أو الشيء إذا نفر فلم يعد
branches.what_is_not_ar: مجرد إعداد الجهاز؛ قتل الجريح؛ سرعة الفرس
branches.source_phrase_ar: ضرب في جِهازه يضرب في الهجران والتباعد (maqayis)؛ يقال للبعير إذا شرد أو مات ضرب في جِهازه (jamhara)؛ في الشيء إذا نفر فلم يعد ضرب في جِهازه وأصله في البعير (sihah)؛ ضرب البعير في جِهازه إذا جفل فند في الأرض والتبط حتى طوح ما عليه من أداة وحمل (tahdhib)؛ ضرب البعير بجِهازه إذا ألقى متاعه في رجله فنفر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir atı koşu ve atılma hızına göre niteleyen dar bir sıfat kullanımını açıkça verir. Burada hız genel bir özellik değil, atın koşu hareketindeki süratidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca atı hızlı koşması bakımından niteleyen söz öbeğidir; genel hız veya başka varlıkların hareketi bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam atla kurulan niteleme öbeğine bağlıdır; çıplak biçime genel hızlılık anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Koşarken ya da ileri atılırken yüksek hıza ulaşan atı niteleyen sözdür.

facets.statement: Nitelenen varlık bir attır ve özellik onun koşu hareketine aittir.
Ayırt edici özellik, koşuda veya ileri atılmada gösterilen yüksek hızdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, atın koşu veya ileri atılma hareketindeki yüksek hızını belirten bir niteleme üzerinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Atın koşu ve atılma süratini doğrudan niteleyen bağlı kullanım için kısa ve doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: At katılımcısı, koşu alanı ve yüksek hız özelliği korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Koşu bağlamının çevre metinde açık olduğu ve atın temel özelliği olarak süratin vurgulandığı yerlerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Atın hareketindeki belirgin hız niteliği korunur.
Yüksek hız niteliğini korur.
error_profile.adds: At dışındaki her varlığı ve koşu dışındaki her türlü hızı kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hız niteliğinin özellikle atı niteleyen dar söz öbeğine bağlı olması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koşuda hız alanını daha genel vermesi ve hızlı koşan at örneğini bu alanın bir örneği olarak taşıması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal atın koşuda yüksek hızı alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnızca atı koşu hızı bakımından niteleyen dar kullanımdır; komşu kart koşu hızı alanını daha geniş verir ve hızlı koşan atı bu alanın örneği olarak gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Atın kalıcı ya da ayırt edici koşu hızı bakımından nitelenmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Atların serbestçe koşması olayını ve başka bir şeye doğru hızla yönelmeyi kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: hızlı at ile hızla ileri atılma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Atın güçlü ve hızlı ileri hareketi iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal atın niteliğini adlandırır; komşu dal koşma veya bir hedefe hızla yönelme olayını anlatır ve at dışına uzanabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Atın koşu hızına sahip olması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başka atların önüne geçme, yarışta önde olma veya topluluk halinde ilerleme.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yüksek hız, atın öne geçmesine yol açabildiği için iki dal aynı yarış sahnesinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hız özelliğini, komşu dal ise başkalarına göre konumu ve üstün gelme sonucunu merkez alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Atın koşuda yüksek hıza ulaşması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayakları veya elleri hafifçe ve çevikçe kullanma ile hızlı yürüyüş, vuruş ya da boynuzlama.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Atın hızlı hareketinde çeviklik ve sürat birlikte görülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğrudan hızı niteler; komşu dal hareket organlarının hafifliği ve çevikliğini merkeze alarak daha geniş eylemlere uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ölümün nedenini, failini veya art arda oluşunu değil, kısa sürede gerçekleşmesini nitelemektedir. Bu nedenle dalın çekirdeği hızlı gelen ölüm olayıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kullanım etkin bir öldürme eylemini değil, ölümün hızlı gerçekleşme biçimini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam ölüm sözcüğüyle kurulan niteleme öbeğine bağlıdır; çıplak biçime genel hız ya da öldürme anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Kısa sürede gerçekleşen, hızlı gelen ölümü niteleyen sözdür.

facets.statement: Nitelenen olay bir canlının yaşamının sona ermesidir.
Ölümün ayırt edici niteliği kısa sürede ve hızlı biçimde gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, ölüm olayını hızlı ve kısa sürede gerçekleşmesi bakımından niteleyen bağlı kullanımda birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ölüm olayının sebebinden bağımsız olarak kısa sürede gerçekleşmesini niteleyen bağlı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ölüm olayı ve onun hızlı gerçekleşme niteliği birlikte korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölümün çok geçmeden veya kısa sürede geldiğinin anlatıldığı akıcı metinlerde kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Ölümün hızla gerçekleşmesi doğal bir söz öbeğiyle korunur.
Yaşamın sona ermesi olayını korur.
error_profile.loses: Olayın kısa sürede ve hızla gerçekleşmesi niteliği kaybolur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ölümün kısa sürede gerçekleşmesi; önceden beklenip beklenmemesi belirleyici değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ölümün ansızın gelerek kişiye vasiyet gibi amaçladığı işleri yapma fırsatı bırakmaması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: hızlı ölüm ile fırsat bırakmayan ani ölüm
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kısa sürede gerçekleşen ölümü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hız niteliğiyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal beklenmedik oluşu ve kişinin yapmak istediği şeyleri kaçırması sonucunu da taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ölümün hızlı gerçekleşmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ölümün birdenbire yakalayan bir baskın gibi kavranması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: hızlı ölüm ile ansızın yakalayan ölüm
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Hız ve ani oluş, kısa sürede gelen ölüm sahnesinde büyük ölçüde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal süreyi öne çıkarır; komşu dal hazırlıksız yakalanma ve beklenmedik baskın imgesini ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Fail ve önceki yaralanma gerektirmeden ölüm olayının hızını nitelemesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir öznenin önceden yaralanmış hedefi hızla öldürüp öldürme eylemini tamamlaması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: hızlı ölüm ile yaralıyı hızla öldürme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da ölüm kısa sürede gerçekleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olayın niteliğidir; komşu dal ise belirli katılımcıları ve tamamlayıcı öldürme eylemini zorunlu kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir ölüm olayının hızla gerçekleşmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir toplulukta ölümlerin biri diğerini izleyecek biçimde art arda gerçekleşmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: hızlı ölüm ile peş peşe ölümler
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal ölüm olaylarının zaman içindeki sıkışıklığıyla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir olayın süresini, komşu dal ise birden çok ölüm arasındaki ardışıklığı belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çıplak biçimin ikincil bir anlamını doğrudan kadının cinsel organı olarak verir. Bu anlam hazırlanmış eşya dalından bağımsız bir eşadlılık oluşturur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kadın cinsel organıyla sınırlıdır; rahim, erkek organı, cinsel ilişki veya genel kadınlık anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimin bağımsız bedensel anlamı tanımlanır; eşya anlamı veya başka cinsel ve üreme kavramları bu dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kadının cinsel organını adlandıran ikincil bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Adlandırılan beden bölümü kadının cinsel organıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tekil aktarım, sözcüğün hazırlanmış eşya anlamından ayrı olarak kadının cinsel organını adlandırdığını bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kadına özgü beden bölümünü doğrudan ve açıklayıcı biçimde adlandıran çıplak kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kadın katılımcısı ve adlandırılan cinsel organ birlikte korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadının cinsel organının kastedildiği genel açıklama ve çeviri bağlamlarında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kadına özgü cinsel organ göndergesi korunur.
Kadın üreme sistemiyle ilgili bir beden bölümü olma özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dış cinsel organ göndergesi kaybolur.
error_profile.adds: İç üreme organı olan rahim anlamını getirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnızca kadının cinsel organını adlandırması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kadın yanında dişi hayvanların cinsel organını ve bazı kullanımlarda rahmi de kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kadın cinsel organı ile dişinin örtülü organı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kadının cinsel organı göndergesinde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal insan kadının cinsel organına bağlıdır; komşu dal dişi hayvanlara ve rahim yorumuna uzanan daha geniş bir kapsama sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kadının cinsel organına özgü adlandırma.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bacak arası, örtülmesi gereken bölge ve hem erkek hem kadın hem de hayvan cinsel organları için geniş kapsam.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kadın cinsel organı ile örtülmesi gereken bölge
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kadının cinsel organı iki dalın ortak göndergelerinden biridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tek ve kadınla sınırlı anatomik göndergeyi taşır; komşu dal bölgesel, örtmeceli ve cinsiyetler arası daha geniş bir sınıftır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Göndergenin açıkça kadına bağlanması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sağlanan kartta göndergenin cinsiyet ve kullanım kapsamının belirlenmemiş olması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kadının cinsel organı ile genel cinsel organ adı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal cinsel organı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kadın katılımcısını zorunlu kılar; komşu kart aynı göndergenin kimde ve hangi sınırda kullanıldığını belirtmediği için tam eşdeğerlik kurulamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kadının cinsel organının bütünü.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Organın içinde bulunduğu söylenen et parçası veya bezler.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kadının cinsel organı ile içindeki bezler
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı anatomik bölgede yer alan kadın beden bölümlerini konu eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kadının cinsel organının adıdır; komşu dal onun içinde yer alan daha dar bir doku veya bez grubunu adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşu kartları incelendi; anatomik göndergenin cinsiyet, tür, kapsam ve bütün-parça sınırlarını açıklayan dört karşılaştırma yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, akılsızlığıyla örnek gösterilen bir kadın adını ve bu adla kurulan karşılaştırma sözünü açıkça destekler. Aynı adın dişi ayı, ayı yavrusu, dişi kurt veya başkasının yavrusunu emziren dişi kurt için verildiği farklı aktarımlar tek bir gönderge oluşturmaz; bunlar adın ayrı kaynak değişkeleri olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel akılsızlık ya da genel hayvan adı değildir; belirli ad, onunla kurulan karşılaştırma sözü ve ayrışan adlandırma aktarımlarıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam belirli bir ad ve onunla kurulan karşılaştırma sözüne bağlıdır; kökün çıplak anlamı veya bütün kadın ve hayvan adları için genellenemez.

concept_map.definition: Akılsızlığıyla örnek gösterilen bir kadına verilen ad ve bu adla kurulan karşılaştırma sözüdür. Farklı aktarımlar aynı adı dişi ayı, ayı yavrusu, dişi kurt ya da başkasının yavrusunu emziren dişi kurt için de kullanır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir kadın adı, kişinin akılsızlığı ve düşüncesizliğiyle ilişkilendirilir.
Bu kadın adı, birini akılsızlık bakımından daha ileri göstermek için kurulan karşılaştırma sözünde kullanılır.
Bazı aktarımlar adı dişi ayıya veya ayı yavrusuna verir.
Başka aktarımlar adı dişi kurda, özellikle başkasının yavrusunu emziren dişi kurda verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, akılsızlıkla ilişkilendirilen belirli bir kadın adı ve onunla kurulan karşılaştırma sözüdür. Aktarımlar adın kimi tanımladığı konusunda ayrılır; kadın yorumunun yanında dişi ayı, ayı yavrusu ve başkasının yavrusunu emziren dişi kurt yorumları da bulunur.

concept_gloss.text: akılsızlık örneği sayılan kadın adı; ayı veya kurtla ilgili değişken hayvan adı
concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli kadın adı ve karşılaştırma kullanımını, ayrıca tek göndergeye indirgenemeyen hayvan adı aktarımlarını birlikte özetler.

error_profile.preserves: Akılsız kadın adı, karşılaştırma işlevi ve ayı ile kurt çevresindeki ayrışan hayvan göndergeleri korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadın adıyla kurulan karşılaştırma sözünün neye dayandığını açıklayan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kadın göndergesi ile akılsızlık üzerinden örnek olma ilişkisi korunur.
error_profile.loses: Adın kendisi, karşılaştırma kalıbı ve hayvan adı değişkeleri açıkça verilmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adın kadınla değil, başka bir hayvanın yavrusunu emziren dişi kurtla ilişkilendirildiği kaynak değişkesinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dişi kurt ve başkasının yavrusunu emzirme koşulu korunur.
error_profile.loses: Kadın ve akılsızlık anlatısı ile ayı ve ayı yavrusu değişkeleri yer almaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: akılsızlıkta örnek gösterilen kadınla yapılan karşılaştırma sözü
akılsızlık anlatısındaki kadın adı; bazı aktarımlarda ayı veya kurtla ilgili hayvan adı

error_profile.preserves: Kadın adıyla ilişkilendirilen olumsuz zihinsel niteliği korur.
error_profile.loses: Belirli ad, karşılaştırma sözü ve hayvan adı değişkeleri kaybolur.
error_profile.collision: Herhangi bir akılsız kişiyi niteleyen genel sıfatla karışır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yapma, üretme, yaratma veya yokken var etme anlamlarını açıkça aynı çekirdekte toplar. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu üretici ve var edici işlemi doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, var olan bir şeyi başka bir duruma sokmayı, adlandırmayı ya da bir eyleme başlamayı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım herhangi bir özel söz öbeğine bağlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yapmak, üretmek, yaratmak ya da daha önce yokken var etmektir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın yapılmasını, üretilmesini veya varlığa çıkarılmasını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi yapma ile onu yaratıp var etme yönlerini ortak bir üretici eylem altında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin üretilmesi, yaratılması veya yokken ortaya çıkarılması anlatıldığında dalın bütün çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yapma, üretme ve var etme yönlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.text: onu yaptı ya da var etti
contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin veya varlığın ortaya çıkarılışını bildiren tamamlanmış eylem bağlamlarında doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapma ile var etme arasındaki çekirdek anlam genişliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyi yapmak, yaratmak veya var etmek

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İyi ya da kötü her türlü işi ve davranışı da kapsayan daha geniş bir eylem alanına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şeyi yapma ve ortaya çıkarma anlamlarında iki dal geniş ölçüde örtüşür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişi veya şeyi belirli bir duruma, niteliğe ya da konuma getirme işlemini doğrudan bildirir. Verilen örnekler hem görev ve konum kazandırmayı hem de üstün bir niteliğe ulaştırmayı destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada katılımcı varlığını sürdürür ve durumu değişir; onu yoktan üretme, adlandırma veya eyleme başlatma anlamı yoktur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; özel bir söz öbeğinin anlamı genel tanıma taşınmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, birini bir göreve veya üstün bir niteliğe getirmenin aynı durum değiştirme çekirdeğine bağlı olduğunu gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: birini veya şeyi belirli bir duruma getirme
